_doc: OPEN-P6-6A-8 T2 golden fixture — fire_case_coefficient + fire_case_exponent fluid-specific input fields. expected.notes: T1 fire_case_coefficient/exponent field test. PCS with fluid-specific coefficient=71866 (AS 1210 §4.4) + ΔH_vap=208 (Ruling 14) matches XLS PR-025 AS 1210 path G54=649808.14 W within 0.0289% (XLS EXACT rel≤1e-3) and G55=11253.17 kg/hr within 0.0287% (XLS 1% per SPEC §5).
